10 checks for gifting flight simulator software and add-ons

A digital simulator gift can be convenient, but the wrong edition or platform can make it unusable. Existing owners may already have the aircraft or scenery you are considering. This guide focuses on choosing and delivering software accurately, with the recipient’s account and preferences leading the process.

By Pilot Gift Guide · How we choose

IN THIS GUIDEHow to chooseThe listRelated guides

How to choose

Use official product and gifting information, and avoid buying from an unfamiliar key seller solely for a discount. Check system requirements, account region, refund rules, and installation needs. A digital gift should not require the recipient to reveal passwords or accept an unwanted recurring charge.

The list

Our selections prioritize personal relevance, usefulness, and fit for the recipient. Named products and destinations link to official sources where applicable.

  1. 1

    The exact simulator

    Confirm whether the recipient uses X-Plane, Microsoft Flight Simulator, or another product. Add-ons should be selected for the specific supported simulator and version.

  2. 2

    Platform and storefront

    Check where the recipient owns the base software. Compatibility with a simulator name does not necessarily establish compatibility with every platform or store edition.

  3. 3

    Existing library

    Ask for a wish list or confirm ownership discreetly. A duplicate add-on can be difficult to exchange after redemption.

  4. 4

    Base-software requirement

    Read whether the purchase needs another product to function. Make sure the gift does not conceal an additional required purchase.

  5. 5

    Current system requirements

    Use the developer’s specifications for the exact version. Avoid promising performance on hardware that has not been assessed against those requirements.

  6. 6

    License type

    Confirm personal-use terms and any restrictions relevant to the recipient. Do not treat an entertainment license as authorization for other uses.

  7. 7

    Gift redemption process

    Check whether direct gifting is supported and how the recipient receives access. Keep their account credentials private and under their control.

  8. 8

    Regional restrictions

    Verify country and currency rules before buying credit or a key. A code sold in one market may have limited redemption elsewhere.

  9. 9

    Refund conditions

    Read the current policy before installation or redemption. Digital purchases can have different terms from boxed hardware.

  10. 10

    A personal introduction

    Explain why you chose the aircraft, scenery, or software. Include the official instructions without turning the gift message into a complicated setup manual.
